metadata.label: Synthetic demonstration data — not live hospital activity.

baseline.description: Mean arrivals for same department, day-of-week, and hour from training data only.

assumptions: Counts are synthetic Poisson draws around department-specific base rates.
Diurnal clinic hours, weekend reduction, mild weekday effects, gradual trend, and rare surge days are simulated.
No real patient registrations, queue entries, access codes, or patient-level records were used.
Patterns may not match any real hospital.

evaluation.label: Held-out evaluation on synthetic data only
evaluation.note: Positive mae_improvement_vs_baseline means the model MAE is lower than the baseline.

simple_week_guide.label: Synthetic demonstration data — simple weekday averages, not live hospital activity.
simple_week_guide.method: Average total patient arrivals per weekday from the full synthetic historical period. This is a basic seasonal day model (no neural net).
